# Tool — Remote MCP server, agent identity / project MI (`type: mcp`)

Attach a remote MCP server that accepts an **Entra ID token minted for a Foundry-managed identity** — no user in the loop, no stored secret. Foundry acquires the token and presents it to the server; you authorize the identity on the target server before the agent invokes it. Needs a **connection** (`--kind remote-tool --auth-type agentic-identity` or `project-managed-identity`) scoped to the upstream resource via `--audience`
